Website owner: Leighton Hepworth. Updated 21 October 2026.

Browsing this website

This personal website presents my businesses, studies and projects. It has no account registration, newsletter or advertising integration. Google Analytics and your cookie choices are described below. Its project filters and notes work in your browser and are not sent to me.

Contact and external websites

The contact selector changes which website a link opens. It does not collect or send a message. If you choose a business website or GitHub, that service has its own privacy information and any enquiry is handled there.

Device features

The copy-link button writes the public website address to your clipboard only when you press it. Your analytics choice is stored in your browser for up to 180 days so that the website can remember it. If storage is blocked, your choice applies to the current visit.

Analytics and your cookie choice

If you accept analytics, this website uses Google Analytics 4 to understand visits, pages viewed, interactions, referring websites, approximate location and browser or device information. Google receives this information. The website does not send contact messages or form-field contents through its own analytics code.

The Google tag loads when you open the public website. Until you accept analytics cookies, or if you decline them, Google can receive consent signals and measurements without cookies for basic measurement and modelling. Analytics cookies are not read or written in this state. Advertising features and personalised advertising are disabled. The first-party cookies _ga and _ga_80ZJ15H2XX identify browser visits; they are configured to expire after 90 days. Your consent preference is separate and lasts up to 180 days.

Use Cookie settings to accept or decline at any time. Declining cookies updates Google's consent state and removes this site's analytics cookies. Measurements without cookies may still be sent. Information already sent is not removed by changing the browser preference. Google's privacy policy explains Google's processing.

Hosting and access

OpenAI Sites and Cloudflare provide hosting and technical security. They may process connection information and operational logs needed to serve and protect the site. Public pages are available without creating an account. The hosting providers have their own privacy information for their services.

Questions

Use the GitHub profile linked from this website to identify the website owner and their public project presence. Business-specific privacy enquiries should use the contact route on the relevant business website.

Help me improve this website
